corrections.change: Do not use failure of dimension-efficient rates alone to reject literal consistency. Distinguish proved conditional consistency, unestablished source-model coverage, and the stronger efficient objective.

State E||X||^2<infinity for coordinate-moment identification; for the Gaussian L2 statistical extension use bounded X or E||X||^4<infinity and require L2 density for every weighted measure used. Specify ratio convergence in probability and denominator fallback.
Require unique interior closest-point projections and finite conditional covariance; interpret exact-level conditional laws almost everywhere. Injectivity alone is insufficient at endpoints.
Require joint measurability in training sample and covariate, and deterministic index ties or conditionally response-independent randomness.
New candidate auxiliary proof is not independently reviewed; obtain a fresh review before changing solved or publication claims.
